title: CALOS: Control-Affine Lyapunov On-manifold Safety Layer for Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning for Quadrotors
abstract: arXiv:2609.17758v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning has demonstrated remarkable capability in quadrotor control, yet learned policies offer no guarantee of respecting safety constraints during training or deployment. We present CALOS (Control-Affine Lyapunov On-manifold Safety), a runtime safety layer that enforces attitude constraints on a quadrotor without modifying the underlying learning algorithm. CALOS formulates four tilt-angle inequalities and a Lyapunov descent condition as a single quadratic program whose solution is the minimum-norm correction to the nominal torque output of the policy. The quadratic program is solved exactly via active-set enumeration over the three-dimensional torque space, with a computational cost low enough to enforce constraints in real time across thousands of parallel simulation environments, as required by modern massively parallel Deep Reinforcement Learning training. Evaluated on trajectory-tracking tasks in NVIDIA Isaac

translated_title: CALOS：面向四旋翼无人机安全深度强化学习的控制仿射李雅普诺夫流形上安全层
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习在四旋翼无人机控制领域已展现出卓越的能力，但学习到的策略无法保证在训练或部署过程中遵守安全约束。我们提出了CALOS（控制仿射李雅普诺夫流形上安全），这是一种运行时安全层，能够在不修改底层学习算法的情况下对四旋翼无人机强制执行姿态约束。CALOS将四个倾角不等式和一个李雅普诺夫下降条件表述为单个二次规划问题，其解为对策略标称力矩输出的最小范数修正。该二次规划通过在三维力矩空间上进行活动集枚举被精确求解，其计算成本足够低，可以在数千个并行仿真环境中实时强制执行约束，这满足了现代大规模并行深度强化学习训练的需求。该方法在NVIDIA Isaac平台的轨迹跟踪任务上进行了评估（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出CALOS运行时安全层，将倾角约束和李雅普诺夫下降条件表述为二次规划，通过对策略输出的力矩进行最小范数修正，在不修改学习算法的前提下实现对四旋翼无人机深度强化学习的实时姿态安全保证。
en_tdlr: CALOS is a runtime safety layer that enforces attitude constraints on quadrotors in deep reinforcement learning by formulating tilt-angle inequalities and a Lyapunov descent condition as a quadratic program, applying minimal-norm corrections to the policy's torque output in real time without modifying the learning algorithm.
